pinFiles.covers: the producer contract with an injected preview and an injected commit: approve sends the exact previewed request plus the captured reason, sends no reason field when nothing was typed (or only whitespace), refuses to commit before a preview, and the reason appears in NO other emitted argument, in none of the hook's returned values, in neither web storage, and in no rendered text
